text: Following the existing `length.py` pattern, I'll add `units/pressure.py` and `tests/test_pressure.py`.

All 6 tests pass, including the pre-existing `test_length.py` regression.

**Implementation:** Added `units/pressure.py` with `to_pascal(value, unit)` mirroring the existing `length.py` pattern (factor-dict lookup, `ValueError` on `KeyError`), supporting `Pa`, `kPa`, `bar`, `atm` (101325 Pa exactly per the cycle decision). Added `tests/test_pressure.py` covering all four units plus the unknown-unit error case.

**Evidence:** `python3 -m unittest discover` — 6/6 pass (1 pre-existing length test + 5 new pressure tests).

No deviations from the workplan; no upstream challenge needed.
